card: PR-AMORT / E1 -- conditioning of the per-image Phi-71 fit

what_was_measured.effective: cond(Phi^T Lambda Phi), Lambda = (dm/ds * sech^2(q/3) * alpha)^2 at the oracle solution -- the Gauss-Newton Hessian in w_dir of the fit the oracle actually solved
what_was_measured.caveat: the Where-A oracle is NOT a linear WLS: it is a multi-start non-linear fit of soft_iou_minmax over (w_dir, w0, alpha, rho). m depends on w_dir only through phi @ w_dir, which is what makes A^T Lambda A the right object anyway.

oracle_w_star.note: w_dir is a normalised DIRECTION with a canonicalised sign (latent.sign_index): the solution set has an exact 2-fold symmetry that a w-space regressor sees as bimodal unless the canonicalisation is applied identically at train time.
oracle_w_star.note_w_raw: w_raw is the literal w* (unnormalised); w_dir = w_raw/||w_raw||. Both reported.

multistart_landscape.note: already-on-disk evidence about how bumpy the per-image objective is: each record stores the loss of every restart

VERDICT.gate: condition number median < 1e2 AND no near-zero spectrum -> M1 downgraded
